encoding: H.264 High + AAC-LC, used as supplied. 1280x720, 30 fps, 8.000s, stereo AAC about 160 kbps. Not retimed and not slowed back to the 12s cut.

deliveryRepresentation.reason: Bilibili Toy publishes a fixed suffix whitelist that includes audio/video .mp4 (alongside .mp3 .wav .ogg .m4a .webm). The desktop packager previously copied the stricter Xiaohongshu image list and rejected .mp4; it now accepts .mp4 so this build can ship the film with its own soundtrack. Xiaohongshu builds are unchanged and still use the portrait animated WebP.

credits: Grok Imagine generated video, 2026-11-10. Original synthesized music by 视频制作官. Tian approved this 8 second landscape cut and asked for the opening to stay shorter than the previous film.

poster.note: First frame of the same 8s film, used only as the landscape loading still.

edit.gameplayHandoff: Last 350ms overlay dissolves into the live authored ivory table while the camera holds the film's final top-down framing, then eases 1.2s to the first-person play pose. Skip, reduced motion, hidden page and load failure still jump straight to play.

limitations: The generated terrace and the live castle table are different renders. The handoff matches the final top-down table size and cue-ball orientation, not pixel identity.
Portrait viewports on this branch keep arrival.webp. This file is selected only by the Bilibili Toy build when the viewport is landscape.

openingMusic.origin: Original soundtrack embedded in the approved 8s landscape film
openingMusic.processing: Already loudness-normalized in the supplied file. Playback uses that audio track with the existing default-on control: sound starts with the picture when the browser allows it, otherwise the music button shows 轻触有声 and a tap on that control unmutes without skipping.
openingMusic.selectionBasis: Tian approved the brighter 8s soundtrack. The 12s silent reference was not used.
